dual_protocol_conflict.selection_needs_owner_scope: Owner must specify exactly one final protocol identity/seed source before any effect first-use. No conflicting simultaneous source sessions.

source.origin: historical F3 FIT/CAL spent; new F6 source never created

immutable_effect_receipt_contract.pre_firstuse: Validate exact protocol SHA + runner+source+owner+receipts+budgets+first-use approval before any upstream import/reset/constructor
immutable_effect_receipt_contract.session_key: (plan_sha, split, block, world_index, policy) unique, one source session per policy/seed; no retry on uncertainty
immutable_effect_receipt_contract.intent_before_effect: Write separate O_EXCL intent for each action with exact step, model, state4, chosen binary action and ledger hash; flush/fsync; owner-side directory persistence on WSL must be verified. Only after confirmed durable intent may trusted external source execute action.
immutable_effect_receipt_contract.effect_after_source: Append immutable O_EXCL factual outcome with chosen action, post4 state, reward, termination/truncation, per-action receipt and source run id, fsync; update RLS only after same-action confirmed outcome
immutable_effect_receipt_contract.crash_or_unknown: A durable attempt without immutable factual outcome blocks retry of that action or source session, including after process restart; operator must reconcile read-only; no uncertain effect replay or speculative rollback
immutable_effect_receipt_contract.cal_before_fit: Deny CAL until all FIT controls trained, strongest baseline selected FIT-only and pinned; do not use CAL or OOD in parameter selection
immutable_effect_receipt_contract.double_ledger: No external effects from pure test ledger, all simulated receipts must carry fixture: prefix; source receipts are rejected until separately qualified adapter

conventional_control_qualification.strong_fully_trained_control: Independently train and source-qualify conventional SSM predictor and policy on each FIT stream with matched action/outcome/compute and early term reporting; this firstuse cannot do so without actual source
conventional_control_qualification.minimum_FIT_baseline_competence: Prospective first check: strongest conventional (including SSM if admitted) mean survival >=24/96 and truthful no-discard 48 FIT episodes; below => no CAL
conventional_control_qualification.FIT_selection: Within same prospective protocol, calculate mean realized survival over all 3x16 FIT worlds per arm. Highest wins; tie lower mean physical stability cost, then fixed arm order. Source receipts must be authenticated before scientific use.
conventional_control_qualification.CAL_admission: Missing FIT/SSM qualification and unresolved protocol fork keep CAL denied. Synthetic fixture can test algorithm but cannot certify competence or first-use authority.
conventional_control_qualification.evaluation: predeclared 3 CAL blocks, independent policy sessions, world equal, source early termination retained, 95% paired bootstrap only if true source and independent owner, no synthetic counterfactuals

tests.scope: pure on-host synthetic fixed-typed fixtures, filesystem O_EXCL/fsync ordering on temporary test directory, injected unknown effect crash simulation, source authorization/refusal, FIT selection shape/competence tests; no external imports/real actions
